verdict.rationale: Grafana Cloud Frontend Observability is documented as automatically capturing real-user errors, logs, and client-side traces for analysis, which covers only the error-capture foundation of this story. Nothing in the pack shows grouping errors into issues, stack-trace views, release tracking, or regression detection. Missing for 10: error grouping into issues, stack-trace display, release/version tracking, regression detection, any hands-on or independent corroboration.
